plot: At sunset in the new house's pantry the bros open the old baker's bread box and find a bubbling sourdough jar called Mother that someone fed this morning while the spare key is missing; they build a soup-can burglar alarm and hide, but Lolly links the warm cinnamon smell to the one person who bakes every dawn — too late, the tower crashes on Grandma, whose name is Rosie: the baker Walter kept the starter alive for her for fifty years; she mixes his harvest dough for every porch on the street at first frost, but at midnight the dough hasn't risen at all.

script.title: Who Keeps Feeding the Baker's Old Jar?

beats.say: The lid is moving! Something in there is bubbling!
Then we open it. Who lives in the baker's bread box?
Sunset in the pantry of the new house. The lid creaks open.
Inside sits an old glass jar. Something in it goes pop.
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Calm down. It's sourdough starter. Flour, water and wild yeast.
The tag says: Mother. Since 1974. Feed her every day.
The baker left a year ago. So who's feeding her?
Zeek touches the flour on the rim. Soft. Fresh.
Fed this morning. Someone was in our pantry today.
And the cloth smells like warm cinnamon. Mmm.
Lolly, every kitchen smells like cinnamon. Focus.
Pim looks at the key hook by the back door. It's empty.
The old spare key is gone! Anybody could walk in!
Whoever feeds her comes back. Feeding time is our trap.
Starters eat twice a day. Morning, and five o'clock.
The pantry clock says ten to five.
If a stranger has our key, Mia isn't safe. Nobody is.
We catch them first. Zeek, build an alarm. Now.
Zeek stacks soup cans into a tall tower behind the door.
One push of that door and the whole house wakes up.
Pim leans on the tower for a little rest. It sways.
Pim. Do. Not. Lean. On. The. Alarm.
S-sorry! My legs get scared too!
Behind them, the jar bubbles up and over the rim.
Mother is escaping! Somebody catch her!
Bup scoops the sticky goo back with a bottle cap.
It's warm. It's sticky. It's like holding a sneeze.
The bros hide behind the flour sack. The light turns orange.
Footsteps in the hall. Slow ones. Then a jingle. A key.
Wait. That cinnamon again. Stronger. It's coming from the hall.
The stranger smells like cinnamon? That's the scariest part!
Lolly thinks. Cinnamon. Flour on the hands. Up before the sun.
Who bakes every single morning in this house? Who?
Stop the alarm! Don't let those cans fall!
Too late. The door swings open. The tower falls. Crash!
Two quick, floury hands catch the last can in the air.
Grandma bakes every morning. Grandma smells like cinnamon. It's her!
We built a burglar trap... for Grandma.
She turns the tag over. Lolly reads the back.
For Rosie, if she ever comes back to Maple Street. Walter.
Rosie. Grandma is Rosie. She grew up on this street!
So the key isn't a stranger's. Walter sent it to her.
Grandma whispers to the jar. Hello, old girl. My turn now.
Fifty years of feeding one jar for a friend. Respect.
Sorry, Grandma. Great alarm. Wrong burglar.
Grandma mixes flour, water and Mother in a big bowl.
Walter's harvest bread, she says. One loaf for every porch.
First frost tonight. She'll bake at five in the morning.
At midnight, the bros check the bowl. Not one bubble.
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Who Keeps Feeding the Baker's Old Jar? 🍞 (Ep 20)
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"We built a burglar alarm. It caught Grandma." — Bup
The old baker's bread box hides a living jar that somebody fed this morning, and the spare key is gone — so the Dough Bros set a soup-can trap in the pantry and wait for five o'clock.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

es.title: ¿Quién sigue alimentando el viejo frasco del panadero? 🍞 (Ep 20)
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la siguiente parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Construimos una alarma antirrobo. Atrapó a la abuela." — Bup
La vieja panera del panadero esconde un frasco vivo que alguien alimentó esta mañana, y la llave de repuesto ha desaparecido: los Dough Bros montan una trampa de latas en la despensa y esperan a las cinco.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Quem alimenta o velho pote do padeiro? 🍞 (Ep 20)
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"A gente montou um alarme contra ladrão. Ele pegou a vovó." — Bup
A velha caixa de pão do padeiro esconde um pote vivo que alguém alimentou hoje de manhã, e a chave reserva sumiu — os Dough Bros armam uma torre de latas na despensa e esperam dar cinco horas.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.title: من يطعم برطمان الخبّاز القديم؟ 🍞 (Ep 20)
ar.description:
ماذا تظن أنه سيحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"صنعنا جهاز إنذار ضد اللصوص. فأمسك بالجدة." — بوب
صندوق خبز الخبّاز القديم يخفي برطمانًا حيًّا أطعمه أحدهم هذا الصباح، والمفتاح الاحتياطي اختفى — فينصب الأصدقاء فخًّا من علب الحساء في المخزن وينتظرون الساعة الخامسة.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Qui nourrit encore le vieux bocal du boulanger ? 🍞 (Ep 20)
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la prochaine partie ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"On a fabriqué une alarme anti-voleur. Elle a attrapé Mamie." — Bup
La vieille boîte à pain du boulanger cache un bocal vivant que quelqu'un a nourri ce matin, et la clé de secours a disparu : les Dough Bros montent un piège de boîtes de conserve dans le cellier et attendent cinq heures.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: パン屋の古いビンにエサをあげているのは誰？ 🍞 (Ep 20)
ja.description:
次のパートで何が起きると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「泥棒よけのアラームを作った。つかまえたのはおばあちゃんだった。」— バップ
前のパン屋が残したブレッドボックスには、今朝だれかがエサをあげた“生きているビン”。しかも合鍵が消えた——ドウ・ブロスはパントリーに缶のタワーのワナをしかけ、5時を待つ。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 누가 제빵사의 낡은 병에 먹이를 줄까? 🍞 (Ep 20)
ko.description:
다음 편에서는 무슨 일이 일어날까요? 댓글로 알려 주세요.
"도둑 잡는 알람을 만들었어. 할머니가 걸렸어." — 법
옛 제빵사의 빵 상자 속에는 누군가 오늘 아침 먹이를 준 살아 있는 병이 있고, 예비 열쇠는 사라졌다 — 도우 브로스는 식료품실에 통조림 탑 함정을 만들고 다섯 시를 기다린다.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Wer füttert das alte Glas des Bäckers? 🍞 (Ep 20)
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Wir haben eine Einbrecher-Alarmanlage gebaut. Sie hat Oma erwischt." — Bup
Im alten Brotkasten des Bäckers steht ein lebendiges Glas, das heute Morgen jemand gefüttert hat, und der Ersatzschlüssel ist weg – also bauen die Dough Bros in der Speisekammer eine Dosenfalle und warten auf fünf Uhr.
#Serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
